FIFA President Infantino faces power struggle amid governance review

FIFA President Gianni Infantino appears set to remain in his position, but the organization is confronting a new conflict regarding its power structures. Infantino has reiterated his commitment to an independent review of FIFA's governance, stating, 'It's about doing what's right for the game.'
